mapper.select: SELECT r.round_id, r.group_id, (DATEDIFF(#{settlementDate}, r.start_date) - 1) DIV 7 AS week_no, DATE_ADD( r.start_date, INTERVAL ((((DATEDIFF(#{settlementDate}, r.start_date) - 1) DIV 7) - 1) * 7) DAY ) AS week_start_date, DATE_SUB(#{settlementDate}, INTERVAL 2 DAY) AS week_end_date, g.min_count FROM rounds r INNER JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = r.group_id WHERE r.round_status = 'ONGOING' AND DATE_SUB(#{settlementDate}, INTERVAL 2 DAY) BETWEEN r.start_date AND r.end_date AND DATEDIFF(#{settlementDate}, r.start_date) >= 8 AND MOD(DATEDIFF(#{settlementDate}, r.start_date) - 1, 7) = 0 ORDER BY r.round_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO weekly_settlements ( round_id, week_no, user_id, approved_post_count, created_at ) SELECT participant.round_id, #{weekNo}, participant.user_id, COUNT(p.post_id), NOW() FROM round_history participant LEFT JOIN posts p ON p.round_id = participant.round_id AND p.user_id = participant.user_id AND p.post_status = 'APPROVED' AND p.posted_at >= #{weekStartDate} AND p.posted_at < DATE_ADD(#{weekEndDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) WHERE participant.round_id = #{roundId} GROUP BY participant.round_id, participant.user_id
mapper.update: UPDATE round_history rh INNER JOIN weekly_settlements ws ON ws.round_id = rh.round_id AND ws.user_id = rh.user_id INNER JOIN rounds r ON r.round_id = rh.round_id INNER JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = r.group_id SET rh.success_count = rh.success_count + 1, rh.remaining_fail_pass_count = CASE WHEN g.min_count > ws.approved_post_count THEN rh.remaining_fail_pass_count - (g.min_count - ws.approved_post_count) ELSE rh.remaining_fail_pass_count END WHERE rh.round_id = #{roundId} AND g.group_id = #{groupId} AND ws.week_no = #{weekNo} AND ( ws.approved_post_count >= g.min_count OR ( g.min_count > ws.approved_post_count AND g.min_count - ws.approved_post_count <= rh.remaining_fail_pass_count ) )

UPDATE group_users gu INNER JOIN weekly_settlements ws ON ws.user_id = gu.user_id INNER JOIN round_history rh ON rh.round_id = ws.round_id AND rh.user_id = ws.user_id INNER JOIN rounds r ON r.round_id = ws.round_id AND r.group_id = gu.group_id INNER JOIN `groups` g ON g.group_id = r.group_id SET gu.streak_count = gu.streak_count + 1 WHERE gu.group_id = #{groupId} AND ws.round_id = #{roundId} AND ws.week_no = #{weekNo} AND ( ws.approved_post_count >= g.min_count OR ( g.min_count > ws.approved_post_count AND g.min_count - ws.approved_post_count <= rh.remaining_fail_pass_count ) )
